subject: See shipping before you decide
preview_text: Resume checkout for the EUR 80 CanvasTrail weekend bag.
headline: See the shipping charge before you decide
body:
The EUR 80 CanvasTrail canvas weekend bag is still in your basket.

If you want to know the shipping charge before deciding, resume the purchase path. Shipping charges are shown at checkout, where you can consider that amount alongside the bag’s EUR 80 price.

Seeing the charge does not decide for you. It simply gives you the shipping information that is not available in this message, so you can make the next decision with both the EUR 80 price and checkout charge in view.

Whenever you’re ready to reconsider the bag, return to the basket and take it from there.
